pictures.name: JMA1-Crowns
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A misty mountaintop high above the clouds at dawn. Moses, an old man with long white hair in a plain undyed wool robe, seen only from behind (his face never visible), stands in the middle of the frame facing a vast, soft radiance of gold light. Inside the light float countless tiny glimmering golden crowns, like sparks. No figure in the light, only brightness. Awe, deep blue shadows in the mist.

pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A large ancient stone study hall lit by oil lamps. At the front, Rabbi Akiva, a lean, bright-eyed teacher in his sixties with a grey beard, in a deep blue mantle over a cream robe, teaches with animated hands. Rows of students in robes sit on low benches, leaning in. In the foreground, at the very back row, sits Moses, an old man with long white hair in a plain undyed wool robe, seen only from behind (his face never visible), small among the students. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue shadows.

pictures.name: JMA5-Scribe
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Today: a scribe’s quiet workroom, painted in the same oil style. A sofer, a man in his forties with a dark beard and a black skullcap, bends over a long sheet of cream parchment, a feather quill poised over a blank part of the sheet and a small inkwell beside him; the parchment shows only faint soft grey lines, no letters visible. A lamp glows warm gold, deep blue shadows, total focus.
